scripts.generate:types: npm run generate:types --workspace=@amp/swagger && npm run generate:types --workspace=@amp/mfe-reporting
scripts.build: npm run generate:types && npm run build:billing && npm run build:accounts && npm run build:trading && npm run build:reporting && npm run build:shell
scripts.dev: npm run generate:types && npm run build:billing && npm run build:accounts && npm run build:trading && npm run build:reporting && concurrently -k --kill-others-on-fail -n api-java,bff-reporting,telemetry,billing,accounts,trading,reporting,shell,viz -c red,blue,gray,yellow,cyan,magenta,white,green,blueBright "npm run dev:api-java" "npm run dev:bff-reporting" "npm run dev:arch-telemetry" "npm run dev:billing" "npm run dev:accounts" "npm run dev:trading" "npm run dev:reporting" "npm run dev:shell" "npm run dev:visualizer"
scripts.kill:dev: bash -c 'P=$(lsof -ti :5173 -i :5174 -i :5175 -i :5176 -i :5177 -i :5199 -i :8088 -i :8085 -i :8090 -i :8091 | sort -u); if [ -z "$P" ]; then echo "no dev processes on 5173-5177/5199/8088/8090/8091"; exit 0; fi; echo "$P" | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; S=$(lsof -ti :5173 -i :5174 -i :5175 -i :5176 -i :5177 -i :5199 -i :8088 -i :8085 -i :8090 -i :8091 | sort -u); if [ -n "$S" ]; then echo "$S" | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; fi; echo "dev ports cleared"'
